fields.statement: QA cycle 2: built rhiza to a scratch path; hermetic root with 3000 recorded claude-code sessions over a TMPDIR scratch tree of 1500 non-session folders in claude-1000/cwd-{a,b,c}, 40 three-day-old session folders, 10 fresh ones and one old symlink named as a session. rhiza daemon --once under strace: each scratch parent listed once (no per-session glob), 40 old folders removed, 'leftovers sweep freed 39.1 KiB: 0 index databases, 40 session scratch folders' logged, fresh folders and the symlink target untouched. go test ./internal/leftovers/... ./internal/adapter/... and the api leftovers/session tests pass

QA cycle 2: rhiza daemon --once in the scratch root started the sweep from the poll and still wrote the freed line before exiting (the daemon waits for a running sweep); go test ./internal/api -run TestDaemonSweepLeftovers and ./internal/daemon/... pass

QA cycle 2: a git wrapper on PATH that hangs 'for-each-ref' (sleep 300); rhiza daemon --once ran 1m32s: each of the 3 hung git calls was killed at 30 s (no sleep left behind), the poll went on and the daemon exited 0. go test ./internal/api -run TestPollGit passes

QA cycle 2: same hung-git run logged 'watchdog: poll took 1m31.563s, over its limit of 15s (3 times the 5s poll interval); slowest: p1 starts 30s, p1 demand 30s, p1 notify 30s'; with rhiza.daemon.watchdog.enabled=false no after-poll line. go test ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPollBehind passes

QA cycle 2: hung-git run wrote exactly one 'watchdog: poll still running after 15s, in p1 demand' while the poll ran; none with the watchdog off and the hang in demand. But with rhiza.daemon.watchdog.enabled=false and a git config read hung in the first poll's p1 settings step, the daemon still wrote 'watchdog: poll still running after 15s, in p1 settings' (first poll watched under shipped defaults although the startup already read the settings)

QA cycle 2: strace -f sh -c 'true & exec rhiza daemon --once ...': the daemon image inherited the shell's exited child and waited on it by pid (wait4(<child>, WNOHANG) = <child>), the drivers list left empty, and the poll's own git programs still returned their output. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestReap passes
